Name: Aurland Base
Notes: Preferred quieter base for Stegastein, Aurlandsfjord and Flam area.

Name: Flam Base
Notes: More services but busier and often pricier in July.

Name: Gudvangen Base
Notes: Good for Naeroyfjord access if Aurland/Flam are full.

Name: Loen Base
Notes: Best scenic base for Lovatnet, Loen Skylift and Olden.

Name: Olden Base
Notes: Excellent for Briksdal Glacier and Oldedalen.

Name: Stryn Base
Notes: Practical town base for groceries, EV charging and Geiranger day.

Name: Voss Base
Notes: Good compromise before a noon Bergen Airport arrival; around 1.5-2 hours to BGO.

Name: Bergen Airport Base
Notes: Safest if the flight itself departs around noon or you want no morning stress.

Name: Bergen Base
Notes: Good if you want one last evening in Bergen; airport transfer is longer than Flesland hotels.
